dict.string: OnKey listens to your singing to show how in tune you are. Your recordings stay on your Mac.

OnKey listens to the music playing on your Mac to learn the singer's melody. It never saves the music or sends it. In listening mode a short fingerprint of it (not the audio) goes to Apple's Shazam to name the song.
OnKey asks Spotify, Music or your browser (for YouTube) what's playing and controls playback when you press play, skip or start over.
